title: Cumulative Delta

edits.reason: Intro bullet: 'Shorts piling in aggressively at support = shorts off-sides = potential squeeze up.' The squeeze destination (final leg to:115) is only marked as the 'Short Squeeze Complete' event point; adding a gold target/magnet level makes the up-squeeze destination readable as a price the eye can lift off the axis. 115 sits at the band top (band ~76-118) so it does not clip. Gold = TP/E2E magnet per palette. Low priority since intro is concept-illustrative and the outcome point already exists, but it reinforces the 'off-sides -> squeeze up to here' read without contradicting anything.

addMarkPoints.label: Bearish Divergence — Price HH / Δ Lower High

edits.reason: Two things the lesson explicitly teaches but does not draw. (1) Divergence: 'price makes a new high but cumulative delta makes a lower high = buyers losing steam = hidden bearish divergence' — this is the core read of the setup yet the chart only labels 'Delta: Extreme' at the price high; a markPoint at the price-high bar (first leg is 9 bars, indices 0-8, so the 105 top lands at idx 8 like the existing markPoints) names the divergence the student is told to watch for. Engine auto-de-conflicts the two top labels at idx 8. (2) Squeeze-down destination: 'Very green delta at SSR resistance = longs market-buying aggressively at a supply zone = off-sides and vulnerable' — the off-sides longs get flushed to the final leg to:81, which is currently only an event point ('Long Squeeze Complete'). A gold target/magnet level at 81 (band bottom, ~79-107, valid) makes the squeeze-down destination readable. Changed the auditor's teal to GOLD: this is the flush/target magnet, and teal (support/bullish) would falsely imply a bullish support shelf at the bottom of a downside squeeze.

notes: Re-derived from the chapter text. introChart already draws DBS support line (78, teal), DBS+Red-Delta zone, the cumulative-delta sub-panel, and 4 delta/squeeze event points; only the up-squeeze destination level was missing (low-value add). lessonChart had the two real gaps: the hidden-bearish-divergence event (high value, explicitly taught) and the squeeze-down destination level. quiz.chart is correctly left alone: it is a cutIndex:9 decision scenario whose pre-cut already shows the DBS zone line + zone + delta sub-panel, and the OUTCOME (extreme red delta at DBS, shorts off-sides squeeze, squeeze complete) is correctly routed to revealMarkPoints so the answer is not spoiled before the user responds. Adjusted the auditor's lessonChart target color from teal to gold (TP magnet, avoids implying support at the squeeze-down bottom); accepted the divergence point and pinned it to the price-high bar idx 8; kept the introChart squeeze-target line but flagged it low-confidence given intro is concept-illustrative.
